name: (03) Thaumaturgy (Lure of Flames) — 2 Intermediate — Wall of Fire

system.description:
At a pointed finger and a few syllables, a column of unnatural flame erupts from the empty air, a burning barrier raised wherever the thaumaturge can see.

Casting takes a single action and creates a Wall of Fire roughly six feet in diameter and equal in height, at any spot you can see within 50 feet. If you place it on a person, challenge your Mental Traits against their Physical Traits; on a win the fire shoots up beneath them for one level of aggravated damage. Anyone within or passing through the wall suffers one aggravated level automatically each turn. It burns until you extinguish it, move more than 50 feet away, or are knocked unconscious, sent to torpor or destroyed. You have no special immunity to your own fire. Retest with Occult.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
system.duration: Until extinguished or out of range
